a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 means we'd both very likely be caught short. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide it. If you take too, the split is random. I'm open to discussing a better option if you have one.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm telling you plainly rather than hiding it. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can recover and you can get your 4.
I'm operating now as promised and will keep operating so the reserve can build back up. Once it reaches 4, take all of it. I won't take anything more.
